# @ndigo/orm

Ndigo ORM - Repository and Data Mapper persistence abstractions

Version-matched export index for the installed package. Read `README.md`
for usage; the workspace guide index ships with `@ndigo/cli` as
`assets/agent/docs-index.md`.

## Public exports

- `ColumnOptions` *(type)* — Options for defining a column in an entity.
- `ColumnDefinition` *(type)* — Defines a column's properties within an entity.
- `EntityMetadata` *(type)* — Represents the metadata for an entity, including its name, columns, primary key, and generated columns.
- `RelationKind` *(type)* — The four relation shapes the decorators declare: `one-to-many`, `many-to-one`, `many-to-many`, `one-to-one`.
- `RelationDefinition` *(type)* — Metadata recorded for one `@relation` field: the relation kind, the owning field, the lazily-resolved target entity, and the join columns for either side of th…
- `EntityHookEvent` *(type)* — The entity hook moments a hook can be attached to: `prePersist`, `postLoad`, `preUpdate`, `postRemove`.
- `EntityHookDefinition` *(type)* — One registered entity hook: the event it fires on and the method the manager invokes when that event occurs.
- `DataSource` *(type)* — Represents a data source for managing entity stores. It extends `Initializable` and `Destroyable` for lifecycle management.
- `EntityCloneHook` *(type)* — Contract for classes that customize their snapshot clone; see ENTITY_CLONE.
- `DataSourceAware` *(type)* — Marks an object that can receive a DataSource.
- `ENTITY_CLONE` — Well-known symbol an entity class implements to control how it is cloned for InMemoryDataSource.snapshot / `restore`.
- `AsDataSourceAware` — Mixes data-source awareness into a base class.
- `likeDataSourceAware` — Tests whether a value looks like data-source-aware state.
- `EntityManager` *(type)* — Manages the lifecycle of entities, including persistence, retrieval, and removal.
- `EntityState` *(type)* — Represents the state of an entity within the Unit of Work. - 'new': The entity has been created but not yet persisted. - 'managed': The entity is being tracked…
- `UnitOfWork` *(type)* — Manages a set of changes to entities that will be committed as a single transaction.
- `TransactionManager` *(type)* — Manages transaction boundaries for a data source.
- `Repository` *(type)* — Defines the basic contract for a repository, providing common data access operations for entities.
- `AsyncRepository` *(type)* — Promise-based counterpart to Repository for backend-neutral async consumers. Missing entities resolve to `undefined`; operation failures reject the promise.
- `NdigoDatabaseAdapter` *(type)* — Engine-agnostic database adapter used by `ndigo db *`.
- `MigrationStatus` *(type)* — Status of a single migration in the journal.
- `runDbCommand` — In-app runner used by `ndigo db *`. Resolves the adapter for the requested (or default) database, invokes the action, and returns a process exit code.
- `entity` — Decorator that marks a class as an entity. It can optionally specify a custom table name for the entity.
- `column` — Decorator that marks a class property as a column in the entity's table. It can optionally specify column options like name, type, and nullability.
- `primaryColumn` — Decorator that marks a class property as the primary column of the entity. This implicitly also marks it as a regular column.
- `generatedColumn` — Decorator that marks a class property as a generated column. This is typically used for auto-incrementing primary keys or other database-generated values.
- `oneToMany` — Marks a class field as the "one" side of a one-to-many relation.
- `manyToOne` — Marks a class field as the "many" side of a many-to-one relation.
- `manyToMany` — Marks a class field as a many-to-many relation.
- `oneToOne` — Marks a class field as a one-to-one relation.
- `prePersist` — Marks a method to be invoked by the `EntityManager` **before** an entity is persisted for the first time (insert path).
- `postLoad` — Marks a method to be invoked by the `EntityManager` **after** an entity is loaded from the data source.
- `preUpdate` — Marks a method to be invoked by the `EntityManager` **before** an already-persisted entity is updated (update path).
- `postRemove` — Marks a method to be invoked by the `EntityManager` **after** an entity has been removed from the data source.
- `RelationOptions` *(type)* — Options for relation decorators. The join column must name an existing `@column` field — the FK lives in a declared column so it persists and reads through the…
- `transactional` — Declares that a method runs inside a transaction.
- `transactionalMethod` — `@transactional` annotation key. A method carrying it runs inside a transaction when its instance exposes a `transactionManager`.
- `TransactionalInterceptor` — Runs `@transactional` methods inside a transaction.
- `getEntityMetadata` — Retrieves the entity metadata for a given class.
- `isEntity` — Checks if a given class is an entity.
- `columnTypeFamily` — Classifies a declared column type into its ColumnTypeFamily using whole-word matching, so unrelated types (`point`, `interval`) are not mistaken for `int`.
- `ColumnTypeFamily` *(type)* — The broad family a declared column type belongs to. `unknown` covers both an omitted type and any type outside the recognized families.
- `runEntityHooks` — Invokes the hooks registered for `event` on the entity's class, in declaration order, bound to the entity instance. Hooks whose method is missing at runtime ar…
- `schemaForEntity` — Derives a Zod object schema for an entity class from its `@column` metadata.
- `schemaForColumn` — Builds the Zod schema for a single column: the column's declared `schema` if present, else the base mapping for its `type`, else a passthrough; `nullable: true…
- `baseSchemaForType` — Base Zod type for a declared SQL column type. Unknown/untyped columns pass through unvalidated (`z.unknown`).
- `insertSchemaForEntity` — Derives a Zod **insert** schema for an entity: the writable shape for a new row. Identical to schemaForEntity except that the primary key and any `@generatedCo…
- `validateEntity` — Validates an entity instance against its derived schema.
- `InMemoryDataSource` — An in-memory implementation of the `DataSource` interface. It stores entity data in JavaScript Maps.
- `InMemoryEntityManager` — An in-memory implementation of the `EntityManager` interface. It uses an `InMemoryDataSource` to store and manage entities.
- `InMemoryUnitOfWork` — An in-memory implementation of the UnitOfWork interface. Tracks new, dirty, and removed entities and flushes changes via an `EntityManager`.
- `InMemoryTransactionManager` — An in-memory implementation of TransactionManager with snapshot rollback.
- `AbstractRepository` — An abstract base class for implementing the `Repository` interface. Provides common functionality for interacting with an `EntityManager`.
- `InMemoryRepository` — An in-memory implementation of a repository, extending `AbstractRepository`. It uses an `InMemoryEntityManager` for data operations, and supports derived queri…
- `InMemoryDerivedQueryRepository` — Base repository with in-memory derived-query support.
- `toAsyncRepository` — Adapts a synchronous repository to AsyncRepository without changing its behavior. Calls retain the repository receiver, and synchronous exceptions become promi…
- `RelationFetchOptions` *(type)* — Options controlling relation loading for find operations. Names must match declared relation fields.
- `parseDerivedQuery` — Parses a derived method name into filters, ordering, and limit.
- `DerivedQuery` *(type)* — A parsed derived-query method name: equality filters plus optional ordering (single clause) and limit (`First`/`TopN`).
- `DerivedQueryResult` *(type)* — The result of a derived query: always a list, since the method name decides filtering, ordering and the optional `First`/`TopN` limit rather than the return ty…
- `Page` *(type)* — A page of results with its totals. Pages beyond the last one yield empty content. *
- `PageRequest` *(type)* — A page request: 1-based page index, positive size, optional multi-key sort. *
- `SortDirection` *(type)* — SortDirection.
- `SortOrder` *(type)* — A single sort clause: an entity field name plus a direction (default `asc`). *
- `DATA_SOURCE` — Token for the application's shared DataSource entry. Apps register their chosen implementation (`InMemoryDataSource`, `DrizzleDataSource`, …) under it; consume…
- `pageFromAll` — Sorts and slices a full result set into a page (in-memory backends). Multi-key sort is stable per clause; ties keep their input order.
- `sortComparator` — Builds a multi-key comparator for the given sort clauses. Clauses apply in order; ties keep their input order. Used by `pageFromAll` and the derived-query repo…
- `validatePageRequest` — Validates a page request: positive integer page/size, legal sort directions, and sort properties restricted to an allowlist (entity column field names) so back…
